_source: Ministry of Education / Curriculum Development Centre, Zambia. 'Civic Education Syllabus Grade 10-12' (2013, published by CDC) — Grade 10, Topics 10.1-10.7. Topic and Specific Outcome statements only; Grade 10's table has no separate 'Sub-topic' column populated, so each topic is modeled with a single sub-topic bearing the same name as the topic, purely to satisfy this app's schema. Two genuine duplicate-numbering slips in the source corrected as before (10.6.4 printed twice; 10.7.2 printed twice). Rebuilt 2026-08-31 to add real term/week/reference data from a second real source, 'MINISTRY OF GENERAL EDUCATION, GRADE TEN CIVIC EDUCATION SCHEMES OF WORK' — a real, complete scheme of work covering all 3 grades × all 3 terms, with blank 'SCHOOL:'/'NAME OF TEACHER:' template fields throughout (never filled in), so there is nothing to sanitize. This source's topic order matches this file's existing 7 topics almost exactly, so content/competencies are unchanged — only real term/week placement and references were added. '10.4 Introduction to Human Rights' is genuinely revisited a second time in this source, in Term 3 (weeks 10-11, as 'the Zambian Bill of Rights' — a more advanced pass building on the Term 2 introduction); this file places it once, at its first real introduction (Term 2), consistent with the app-wide convention of dating a sub-topic to when it was first taught rather than every week it was reviewed. This was previously deliberately left unfixed (an earlier available source was Term-3-only and missing 2 of Grade 10's 7 topics) — this new source is genuinely complete, resolving that gap.

curriculum.name: 2013 Outcome-Based Curriculum
curriculum.description: Zambia's 2013 outcome-based curriculum for Grades 10-12 (Senior Secondary).

subject.name: Civic Education
subject.description: Senior Secondary Civic Education syllabus, Grade 10-12 (Curriculum Development Centre, 2013).

sub_topics.name: 10.1 Constitution
sub_topics.references: Teacher's Guide 10; Learner's Book 10; Civic Education Syllabus Grade 10-12

competencies.description: Describe types of constitution
Explain the main parts of the Zambian constitution
Describe the process of constitution making and adoption
Discuss the characteristics of a good constitution
Explain the importance of a constitution to a nation

competencies.description: Explain governance

Analyse different Electoral systems
